The idea in practice.

For Mesa School of Business, we built content IPs around the experiences of an institution focused on the next generation of startup founders.

The work connected the school’s digital presence to what actually happens there: how people learn, the ideas they test, and the startup experiences they encounter.

Show what an education feels like, as well as what it offers.
